description: Connection between B_3 spectral phase and the Q_beta precision ladder. theta = 8*hbar^2 * (1 + d_1*b*hbar^2 + ...) with d_1 = -3.391. The Q_beta ladder uses the SAME eigenvalue b*hbar^2 = 0.00852 but DIFFERENT first coefficient (c_1 = -0.188 for Q_beta vs d_1 = -3.391 for theta). d_1 is close to -[3]_q - 1/3 = -3.377 (0.41% match). Both ladders share eigenvalue b*hbar^2 and c_2 = -1 (geometric/trivial).
